description: Eero mesh network monitoring via eero-prometheus-exporter 4.0.0. Every exported metric family has a panel; optional tiers live in collapsed rows named after the flag that enables them.

panels.title: Networks in account
panels.description: Account-wide; not scoped by the network selector.

targets.expr: sum by (network_id, name, status, isp, wan_type, gateway_ip) (eero_network_info{network_id=~"$network_id"})
sum by (forward_id, description, protocol, client_port, gateway_port) (eero_port_forward_info{network_id=~"$network_id"})

panels.title: Eero inventory

targets.expr: sum by (eero_id, location, model, os_version, ip_address) (eero_eero_info{network_id=~"$network_id"})

options.content:
Closed `status` enum of `eero_exporter_api_requests_total`. Sum failures with `status!="success"`.

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `success` | request completed |
| `error` | unclassified API error |
| `auth` | session invalid or expired; re-run `eero-exporter login` |
| `transport` | network / timeout failure reaching the API |
| `rate_limited` | API rate limit hit; collection backs off |
| `validation` | request rejected as invalid (SDK or API 400) |
| `access_denied` | account lacks permission for this resource |
| `not_found` | resource absent (expected for unprovisioned features) |
| `premium_required` | needs an Eero Plus subscription (expected state) |
| `feature_unavailable` | feature not available on this network (expected state) |
